Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted an incorrect death year for Rafael Gil (1996) from a quick scan of Wikipedia/IMDb and ignored conflicting evidence in the same results (e.g., 1986 on Find a Grave). By not reconciling the discrepancy or verifying with authoritative sources, the Planner concluded “Deuce High,” whereas Rafael Gil (The King Is The Best Mayor) actually died earlier (1986) than Richard Thorpe (1991).
